postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve exactly four digits including leading zeroes. Swiss Post routing assignment and swisstopo public geometry remain independent evidence; a code alone does not identify an entrance, building, recipient or deliverability.
postal_system.npa6_rule: Preserve the additional two-digit Swiss Post code separately as NPA6. Never accept a six-digit routing value as the public NPA4 field or silently truncate it without source-backed semantics.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Use a pinned swisstopo PLZO_CH edition as official Polygon or MultiPolygon evidence for domicile-address postcode types 10 and 20. Professional, company, internal and administrative types greater than 20 may have no public perimeter and remain non-areal unless separately licensed evidence proves otherwise.
postal_system.address_rule: Use the official building-address directory for street, house number, locality, NPA4, municipality, status and LV95 entrance point. Preserve EGAID and the nationwide-unique EGID plus EDID entrance identity, edition and cadastral coordinate provenance.
postal_system.building_rule: EGID is the definitive building identity. A building shape is exact only where the pinned swissBUILDINGS3D canton or tile edition carries the same EGID; entrance containment or footprint proximity alone remains candidate evidence.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Public AGID resolution can display official building-address and public entrance context but excludes EWID dwelling identity, occupant, owner, recipient, forwarding, shipment and non-public GWR attributes.
postal_system.rights_rule: Swiss Post search, street/sorting directories, NPA6, GeoPost postcode maps, coordinates and delivery products remain contract-partitioned. Public swisstopo OGD artifacts require source attribution and pinned fair-use-aware acquisition.
postal_system.territory_rule: Swiss sources can contain Principality of Liechtenstein records. The CH runtime filters them out and publishes Liechtenstein only through a separately governed LI country pack.

exception_classes.rule: Return the pinned PLZO_CH NPA4/NPA6 locality perimeter while preserving Swiss Post assignment and swisstopo geometry authority separately.
Store NPA4 and the additional two-digit NPA6 component separately with postcode type and locality identity; never coerce between four and six digits without an explicit source relationship.
Codes excluded from the domicile-address directory remain routing or organization records and do not receive an invented residential polygon.
Resolve the official address through EGAID and EGID plus EDID, preserving address status, source edition and cadastral entrance coordinate.
Promote swissBUILDINGS3D geometry only when the pinned feature carries the identical EGID. In phased or missing-EGID areas, stop at entrance/building identity or return candidate geometry.
Keep every EDID and EGAID branch separate; do not merge entrances, languages or house numbers into a Franken-address.
Represent a P.O. Box, post office or special delivery destination as a facility or routing record, not a surrounding residential polygon or proof of residence.
Source rows identified as Liechtenstein are rejected by CH release validation and routed only to the LI country pack.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release or receipt, digest, source attribution, access/contract class, schema, CRS, geographic partition and transformation method.
Swiss Post assignment, PLZO geometry, building-address identity, GWR building identity, swissBUILDINGS3D geometry, administration and AGID indexes remain separate.
Polygon and multipolygon geometry is valid, monthly-versioned and checked for unexplained overlaps, gaps, islands, invalid NPA4/NPA6 pairs and territory leakage.
Every code is classified as domicile-area, special non-area, organization/facility, unknown or contract-only; absence from PLZO never creates derived official geometry.
Every promoted address preserves EGAID, EGID, EDID, status, NPA4, locality, municipality, LV95 coordinate provenance and release time.
Every exact geometry has an identical EGID in the pinned swissBUILDINGS3D feature; proximity-only features remain candidates.
Public results contain no EWID dwelling record, occupant, owner, recipient, forwarding, shipment, telephone or non-public register attributes.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, postcode types and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-reviewed snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Topology, identity, privacy, territory, freshness and holdout gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
